about_short_description.short_description: AI agents for data operations. Automate data prep, standardize client files to RFIs, protect project margins.

product.name: Embeddable CSV Importer
product.description: A customizable, embeddable tool that enables users to import and validate CSV files directly within a product interface, handling large files and complex data transformations without manual coding.

product.name: FileFeeds
product.description: An AI-powered workflow builder that automates recurring CSV and PDF file imports by recording and replaying data mappings and transformations without requiring engineering or API integration.

product.name: Code Hooks
product.description: A feature that allows engineering teams to create custom functions to reformat, transform, and validate data during the import process at various stages, enhancing flexibility for unique business logic.

product.name: Data Normalization Engine
product.description: An automated system that resolves common formatting errors in CSV and PDF files to standardize data for easier processing and integration.

product.name: Audit Logging and API
product.description: A system that records detailed logs of all import activities and provides APIs for accessing import data and building automations or analytics.
